children: The dollar extends its gains, hitting a 19-month high against a basket of currencies, supported by expectations for further Federal Reserve interest rate rises. A strong economy and inflation above the Fed's 2% target are keeping expectations for further rate increases alive, ING's Chris Turner says in a note. Price action suggests investors, who are already betting on a stronger dollar, aren't ready to chase the dollar much higher, he says. "But it is hard to stand in the way of a DXY dollar index advance to the next resistance area around 104.60." The DXY dollar index rises 0.3% to 103.858, its highest level since April 2025. (renae.dyer@wsj.com)
